# ig_agent (vendored)

Copied unchanged from https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/instagram-agent-skill
(commit d03c56b), MIT licence (see LICENSE).

- hookscore.py: scores a hook on length, specificity, stakes, front-loading and address.
- humanize.py + slop.json: strips invisible characters, curly quotes, em dashes and stock "AI" phrases.

Used by instagram_poster/content_quality.py. Pure standard library, no network.
